title: TypeScript build excludes generator template files that npm expects under dist
reasoning: The crate generator resolves templates from `__dirname/files/...`, which at runtime is `dist/generators/crate/files/...`. The TypeScript compiler explicitly excludes every `**/files/**` path, so those templates are not emitted by `tsc`; the package manifest only publishes `dist/**/files/**`, so a publish/build that does not copy templates into dist produces a package where `@eddacraft/nxrust:crate`, `:binary`, and `:library` fail at runtime when `generateFiles` cannot find the template directory. The `package.json` build script does run `tools/copy-assets.mjs`, but that script is outside the included evidence; the release-critical contract is split between an exclusion and an unverified custom copy step.
reproduction: Build or pack the package without a successful `tools/copy-assets.mjs` template copy, then run the crate generator from the packed package; `generateFiles` will look for `dist/generators/crate/files/bin` or `dist/generators/crate/files/lib` and those files are not produced by `tsc`.
recommendation: Make the template-copy contract explicit and tested: ensure `tools/copy-assets.mjs` copies `src/generators/**/files/**` into the matching `dist/generators/**/files/**` paths, and add a pack/build assertion that those directories exist. Alternatively, avoid relying on a separate untyped copy step by placing templates where the build/package pipeline includes them deterministically.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The listed generator tests run against source in the repository and do not demonstrate that the built npm artifact contains the runtime template directories under `dist`.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a release/pack test that runs `pnpm build`, inspects `dist/generators/crate/files/bin` and `dist/generators/crate/files/lib`, and invokes the crate/binary/library generators through the built entrypoints rather than source files.
minimumFixScope: Validate or adjust `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, and the asset-copy/build test path that owns generator templates.
